paras: Replace your restrictive factory airbox with this new airbox from Leyo Motorsport. Meticulously engineered, this final design is the culmination of numerous air flow rendering and analysis. High flow air filter ensures maximum air flow eliminating the air flow restrictions found in the stock airbox. More air means more usable power especially when paired with Leyo charge pipe for the MK7 1.4.
Installation is simple and straightforward, in just minutes your engine bay will be transformed with the addition of this Leyo intake kit.
hl: Track and dyno proven for greater horsepower gain.
For MQB vehicles with EA211 1.4 TSI engine.
ft: Cold Air Intake System EA211 MQB V2 -Audi A3 8V & Volkswagen Golf MK7
